label: Thư hoa / Flower Letter (3D: an envelope opens, carnations bloom, a note and your photo rise)

preset.title: Thư hoa
preset.intro: Lay the card flat, point your phone at it and wait a moment.
body: Some flowers that will never wilt, and a few words I wanted you to keep.

groups.title: The note
groups.note: The words on the note that rises out of the envelope, in handwriting. Up to about 40 letters; longer words get smaller. Add a photo too: it pops up in a polaroid at the second stop.
